caption: The drawing features a long-sleeved, knee-length coat with vertical stripes in shades of muted pink, violet, and beige, accented with yellow along the hem and front edges. The coat has a high collar, a row of round buttons down the front, two front flap pockets, and turned-back cuffs with visible white shirt cuffs underneath. In the upper right, there is a smaller rear view of the coat, displaying the same striped pattern and yellow accent on the back hem and cuffs. Above this, there is a simple line drawing outlining the coat's front and collar with visible buttons, providing a sketch of the garment's structure. To the lower right of the coat, there is a rectangular swatch showing a close-up of the striped fabric, highlighting its color arrangement with alternating stripes of varying width and color. The background of the image is a light, plain off-white or beige color, and the objects are evenly spaced within the composition.
title: Dress Coat
